dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Chioriii! Why did you just jump into the sea all of a sudden?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Paimon, what do you think is the most beautiful thing in the sea?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Erm... A Lumitoile? Or a pearl maybe... Ooh, coral's pretty too...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! Paimon gets it now... You want to use things like that as the "accessories" for your designs!

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Well, now that you've hit the nail on the head, help me grab some, would you?
